title: Dated official text used as evidence: transactions, IR moves, announced starters, inactives

source_of_sources.roundup: https://www.nfl.com/news/nfl-news-roundup-latest-league-updates-from-tuesday-nov-10 (official nfl.com news, dated Tuesday Nov 10 in its own slug/title)
source_of_sources.injuries_news_module: the NEWS carousel rendered on https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ (headline text + target URL read from the page itself; article bodies were not opened this session)
source_of_sources.transactions_hub: https://www.nfl.com/transactions/ - named in the roundup preamble: "Visit NFL.com's transaction hub for a daily breakdown"

rows.text: LB Daiyan Henley is being traded to Denver in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round pick and 2028 fifth-round pick ... The teams have since announced the trade.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session
rows.used_for: roster-turnover event; and the conflict EV-02

rows.text: Daiyan Henley appears on the Los Angeles Chargers' Week 10 official injury report (LB, Full Participation in Practice, no game designation) five days after both clubs announced his trade to Denver.
rows.verified: report row transcribed this session (availability_snapshot_2026-11-15.csv) + EV-01
rows.used_for: proof that the injury report is not roster-versioned; a depth/availability row must be keyed to the last official roster event, never trusted as durable

rows.text: WR Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick are being traded to the Chiefs in exchange for '27 fourth- and fifth-round picks ... The teams have since announced the trade.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session

rows.text: WR Keenan Allen is being traded to San Francisco for a 2027 sixth-round draft pick ... The Colts have since announced the trade.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session (sentence spans chunk 0/1)

rows.text: WR Nick Westbrook-Ikhine signed from the practice squad; LS Jacob Bobenmoyer signed (practice squad).
rows.verified: roundup body read this session

rows.text: QB Malik Willis was placed on injured reserve due to a groin injury and will miss at least four games. Kyle McCord is in line to start in Week 10 against the Colts.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session; the linked article itself was not opened
rows.used_for: 'not listed' is not 'available': Willis appears nowhere on the Dolphins' Week 10 report because he is on IR, and McCord (the expected starter) is absent from the report too because he is not designated

rows.text: Neither Malik Willis nor Kyle McCord appears in any row of Miami's Week 10 report section (11 rows: Addington, Allen, Baker, Bell, Brewer, Herring, Kacmarek, Taaffe, Trader, Wayne, Wright).
rows.verified: counted from the capture this session
rows.used_for: the report answers 'who is designated', never 'who is on the roster' - an IR ledger is a separate, required dataset

rows.text: DT Zach Sieler ruptured his biceps in Sunday's loss to Detroit and will undergo season-ending surgery ... Miami placed Sieler on IR.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session
rows.used_for: a starting defensive-tackle loss that will never appear as a game designation - it is only visible in the transaction record

rows.text: QB Kirk Cousins is being acquired from Las Vegas in exchange for a 2027 third-round pick ... The Vikings have since announced the trade.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session (mirrored in the LV entry of the same article)
rows.used_for: a new QB joined the roster mid-week; the Week 10 report shows Kyler Murray (QB, hamstring, DNP, Out) and Carson Wentz (QB, FP) - the acquired starter appears in neither, because he is not designated

rows.text: MIN's Week 10 report: Kyler Murray Out (Hamstring, Did Not Participate) with Carson Wentz Full Participation and no designation.
rows.verified: capture this session
rows.used_for: the surprise, not the level: a starting-QB absence is a Friday delta event, and this is the row a total/side origination has to price

rows.text: NFL news roundup: Patriots place RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) on injured reserve
rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module on the injury-report page; article body not opened
rows.used_for: sequence check: Henderson's report row says Out (Illness, DNP) on Friday, then Saturday he is moved to IR - two official records of the same absence at different strengths

rows.text: Sam Darnold ruled out for Seahawks' Week 10 game vs. Raiders; Drew Lock expected to start again
rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module; article body not opened
rows.used_for: announced-starter evidence for SEA at QB: the replacement is NAMED by the club/league, not inferred from a depth chart

rows.text: Drew Lock (elbow/oblique) has no injury designation, will start for Seahawks vs. Raiders
rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module; article body not opened
rows.used_for: two-sided: the starter has an injury in the text and NO row-level designation (the report shows Lock: LP, blank game status) - which is exactly why 'no designation' must not be read as 'healthy'

rows.text: NFL news roundup: Browns to start QB Deshaun Watson vs. Texans; Cardinals' Carson Beck to start vs. Rams
rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module; article body not opened
rows.used_for: dated starter announcements for two clubs whose Week 10 report rows list no quarterback at all (CLE: 12 rows, 0 QB; HOU: 16 rows, 0 QB; AZ: 15 rows, 0 QB; LAR: 14 rows, QB Stafford only)

rows.text: NFL news roundup: Ravens officially place Lamar Jackson on injured reserve
rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module; article body not opened
rows.used_for: IR confirmation for the QB the reviewer flagged as 'still published on the depth chart after IR'

rows.text: Baltimore's Week 10 report section contains 10 rows and NO quarterback: Ali (RB), Bateman (WR), Campbell (DT), Hamilton (S), Hawkins (S, Out), Hibner (TE), Ioane (G), Randall (RB, Questionable), Stanley (T), Wiggins (CB).
rows.verified: counted from the capture this session
rows.used_for: the reviewer's stale-QB claim (VR-17/VR-26) cannot be reproduced against the live report; and the report is not a depth chart, so the claim needs a depth-chart source that does not exist on nfl.com (see flag RF-04)

rows.text: Two dated official items give two different recovery windows for the same injury: 'Ravens' Lamar Jackson (right thumb) out 6-9 weeks' and 'Ravens confirm Lamar Jackson expected to miss 6-10 weeks'.
rows.verified: both headlines + URLs read in the official news module
rows.used_for: why a store must keep the read with its clock time and publish the delta: 6-9 vs 6-10 weeks is the same fact quoted differently, and a 'level' cannot be reconciled after the fact

rows.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua likely to be placed on injured reserve with turf toe, sprained MCL and PCL
rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module; article body not opened
rows.used_for: conflict EV-19: the injuries column on the official report for the same player is blank

rows.text: Puka Nacua's Week 10 report row: WR, Injuries blank, Did Not Participate In Practice, Game Status blank - while the club/league news says IR with three named injuries.
rows.verified: capture this session
rows.used_for: a designation is not an injury list: the report's injury cell is unreliable as a severity signal, which is the argument for ablations over fixed penalties

rows.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs to undergo surgery on finger this week; timeline to return TBD
rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module; article body not opened
rows.used_for: agreement check: the report row (Finger, DNP, Out) matches the dated news - one of the few clean agreements in this week's data

rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module; article body not opened

rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module; article body not opened this session
rows.used_for: the official inactives evidence exists as a dated per-week article - the route to 'who actually did not play' without a club inactive API; also fixes Week 9 at 13 Sunday games

rows.text: NFL Week 9 injury report: Player statuses for all 15 games
rows.verified: headline + URL read in the official news module; article body not opened this session
rows.used_for: a per-week, dated report article is the archive-friendly artefact for multi-day capture: it is a stable URL per week, unlike the rolling /injuries/ page

rows.text: QB Gardner Minshew was placed on injured reserve; WR Michael Wilson was placed on IR. QB tryouts: Cooper Rush, Trevor Siemian. QB Joey Aguilar signed off Jacksonville's practice squad; QB Josh Johnson signed off Cincinnati's practice squad.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session
rows.used_for: a club that lost both backup quarterbacks to IR in one day and went out on the market for two replacement QBs - the depth of the replacement is visible only in the transaction record, never in a rank

rows.text: S Amani Hooker and a 2027 fifth-round pick were acquired from Tennessee in exchange for a 2027 second-round pick ... OT Dion Dawkins's contract was restructured in order to make room.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session
rows.used_for: roster event and a cap transaction that keeps a player (Dawkins, on the report as FP/blank) on the roster - contracts change, availability does not follow

rows.text: LB Arnold Ebiketie is not expected to be acquired from Philadelphia after previous reports of a trade ... the deal would have impacted the Bengals' compensatory pick formula and cost them a third-round pick they were set to receive after losing Trey Hendrickson.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session
rows.used_for: reported trades that do not happen: a 'reported' move must be stored as a claim, and only an announced move becomes a data event

rows.text: WR Odell Beckham re-signed to the practice squad after being released from the active roster ... Beckham made his Vikings debut on Monday and played two snaps.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session
rows.used_for: the only snap count in any official page read this session ('two snaps') is prose in a news item, not a dataset - the 'model depth from playing time' requirement therefore needs a game-book parser, not a news parser

rows.text: WR Brian Thomas Jr. is not expected to be traded ahead of Tuesday's 4 p.m. ET deadline ... Thomas remained on the Jaguars' roster.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session
rows.used_for: deadline as a schedule fact: the trade deadline is 'Tuesday 4 p.m. ET' in official text - a fixture-context/receipts rule the origination calendar must respect

rows.text: RB Tyler Goodson is expected to miss multiple weeks due to a knee injury, owner Jerry Jones said on 105.3 The Fan on Tuesday.
rows.verified: roundup body read this session
rows.used_for: provenance grading: a club statement quoted in an official roundup is weaker than a transaction entry - it is stored as 'reported', and the report row (Ankle, Knee / DNP / Out) is the only designation-grade fact
